the utilization of semiconductor-industry sludges as an alternative raw material for the manufacture of building materials, which can help reduce environmental problems and energy consumption.

the nano-particles in semiconductor sludge are useful resources to replace portion of Portland cement in cement-based materials.

the sludge, which is a waste material, can be used as a raw material in cement mortar to produce a product that is better than plain cement mortar.
